content:
- Model consistently underestimates prices in recent periods, especially after sharp spikes; adjust downward by 2–5% for post-spike days.
- Overestimates early in the forecast horizon; reduce initial forecast values by 3–8% to align with observed mean reversion.
- Shows persistent lag in capturing downward trends; delay forecast drop by 1–3 days when price declines are confirmed.
- Overreacts to minor volatility; suppress overshoots by smoothing 3–5 day moving average before final output.
- Underestimates long-term mean (30-day average) by 3–7%; adjust forecast mean to match historical 30-day average of past 6–12 months.
- Avoids sharp upward moves in early forecast; if true outcome exceeds 20% above 30-day average, increase forecast by 10–15% only if confirmed by 2 consecutive days.
